blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Senator-judge Raffy Tulfo has scolded the prosecution for instances where they failed to pique the curiosity of senator-judges, as they supposedly fielded witnesses that are not necessary to Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial. During the start of the trial on Thursday, Tulfo asked the prosecution, particularly public prosecutor and Bukidnon Rep. Jonathan Keith Flores when they will present former Senator Antonio Trillanes IV. When Flores said that they will announce the order after the Senate impeachment court goes on a lunch recess, Tulfo said it will be good for the prosecution to present Trillanes first before the Anti-Money […]...
